parts.html: The K-11 kitchen model combines a contemporary grey color palette, stone-effect decorative surfaces, and streamlined furniture design to create a practical and visually distinctive kitchen interior.
Its single-wall configuration provides a clean architectural arrangement, making the model suitable for modern apartments, compact residential spaces, and open-plan kitchen-living areas.

The defining feature of K-11 is its stone-inspired finish. The decorative texture introduces the appearance of natural stone while maintaining a cohesive furniture composition with simple geometric lines.
Grey cabinet surfaces complement light walls, wood textures, metal details, and neutral flooring materials, making the kitchen adaptable to a wide range of contemporary interiors.

The upper cabinet fronts are manufactured from laminated MDF, while the lower cabinet fronts feature laminated particleboard. The coordinated stone-effect decor connects both materials within one consistent design.
With a total linear length of 4.3 meters, the kitchen provides space for integrated appliances, food preparation, and cabinet storage without requiring a separate island.
The countertop uses a chipboard-based material, and the main cabinet construction features 18 mm laminated particleboard.
FREE FOLD Hafele lift mechanisms provide convenient access to the upper cabinets, while Muller Profi Line soft-close hinges ensure smooth door operation.
Concealed Muller Profi Line drawer runners complete the functional hardware configuration.
A pull-out cargo system helps organize kitchen essentials and makes efficient use of the available cabinet space. Cabinet handles are included.
Drawer runners: Concealed Muller Profi Line
DUMSKAYA DESIGN, based in Bratislava, Slovakia, provides custom kitchen design and manufacturing services for apartments and private residences in Bratislava and Vienna.
The K-11 model can be adapted to individual room dimensions, appliance specifications, storage requirements, and architectural features.
Our services include personalized kitchen planning, material selection, cabinet manufacturing, delivery, and professional installation.
Additional equipment, including kitchen sinks, built-in appliances, extractor hoods, and plumbing fixtures, can be selected according to the client's requirements.
Order your K-11 kitchen from DUMSKAYA DESIGN and create a contemporary interior combining stone-inspired textures, efficient storage, and functional European furniture hardware.
